name: ProxCenter
description: Multi-cluster management UI for Proxmox VE and Proxmox Backup Server. Community Edition runs the Docker stack on port 3000; Enterprise adds the orchestrator.

notes.text: Requires Docker inside the LXC; nesting and keyctl are on by default. The stack publishes port 3000 (HTTP + WebSocket), not host networking.
First-run setup is unauthenticated until an admin exists. Keep this LXC on a trusted LAN or behind a reverse proxy.
Never change POSTGRES_PASSWORD after first start unless you reset the postgres_data volume. Behind TLS, set NEXTAUTH_URL/APP_URL and enable the proxy toggle.
Web UI: http://<container-ip>:3000. Add Proxmox VE (8006) and PBS with API tokens. Config: /opt/proxcenter/.env (0600).
Update: `update` in the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`; PHS_SILENT=1 for unattended. Logs: `cd /opt/proxcenter && docker compose logs -f`.
Unattended Community: run ct/proxcenter.sh. Enterprise: `var_edition=enterprise var_install_token=YOUR_TOKEN`; optional `var_license_key`, `var_image_version`.
